personas.zh: 老年居民与低数字能力者
personas.en: Older residents and people with low digital confidence
personas.need_zh: 不扫码、不注册，也能完成问路、办理与求助。
personas.need_en: Complete guidance, service and help without scanning or registration.

personas.need_zh: 把注意力带回真实世界，并保证真人介入和数据零采集。
personas.need_en: Return attention to the physical world with human supervision and zero personal-data capture.

personas.zh: 残障人士与行动不便者
personas.need_zh: 获得连续无障碍路径、等价人工服务与明确停机优先权。
personas.need_en: Continuous accessible routes, equivalent human service and clear stop priority.

personas.zh: 普通居民与无手机使用者
personas.need_zh: 智能关闭后，基础城市仍完整可用。
personas.need_en: The ordinary city remains fully usable when AI is off.

personas.need_zh: 知道AI何时工作、谁负责、争议如何转人工以及退出成本。
personas.need_en: Know when AI is active, who is accountable, how disputes reach humans and what exit costs exist.

personas.zh: 开发者与企业测试团队
personas.need_zh: 在真实城市中获得可失败、可停止、可恢复的测试空间。
personas.need_en: Access a real-city test environment that can fail, stop and restore safely.

personas.zh: 维护人员与公共服务人员
personas.need_zh: 拥有清晰责任、维护窗口、人工接管和退役恢复流程。
personas.need_en: Clear duties, maintenance windows, human takeover and restoration procedures.

scenarios.need_zh: 配送与服务机器人在儿童、轮椅、骑行者和临时障碍共存的街道中学习减速、避让和停机。
scenarios.need_en: Delivery and service robots learn to slow, yield and stop among children, wheelchairs, cyclists and temporary obstacles.
scenarios.ai_role_zh: 低速导航、冲突预测和人工接管提示
scenarios.ai_role_en: Low-speed navigation, conflict prediction and human-takeover alerts
scenarios.minimum_data_zh: 匿名近距障碍类别与设备状态；不采集人脸和身份
scenarios.minimum_data_en: Anonymous near-field obstacle class and device state; no face or identity data
scenarios.human_route_zh: 现场安全员与实体停止键
scenarios.human_route_en: On-site safety steward and physical stop button
scenarios.ai_off_zh: 人工围挡、普通交通标识与步行优先规则继续工作
scenarios.ai_off_en: Manual barriers, ordinary signs and pedestrian-priority rules remain
scenarios.stop_zh: 近失事件、超速、盲道占用或生态缓冲越界即停
scenarios.stop_en: Stop on near-miss, speeding, tactile-path obstruction or habitat-buffer breach
scenarios.restore_zh: 机器人撤离，路面恢复普通公共通行
scenarios.restore_en: Remove robots and return the surface to ordinary public passage

scenarios.title_zh: 断网仍可服务的公共问询
scenarios.need_zh: AI问询失效或居民拒绝使用时，仍能通过纸本地图、人工桌和电话完成同一任务。
scenarios.need_en: When AI guidance fails or is declined, paper maps, a staffed desk and telephone service complete the same task.
scenarios.ai_role_zh: 多语问答与无障碍路线建议
scenarios.minimum_data_zh: 即时问题与目的地，不保存身份
scenarios.minimum_data_en: Immediate question and destination, without identity retention
scenarios.human_route_zh: 同一地点的有人值守服务台
scenarios.human_route_en: A staffed desk at the same location
scenarios.ai_off_zh: 纸质导视、电话和人工服务保持开放
scenarios.ai_off_en: Paper wayfinding, telephone and human service remain open
scenarios.stop_zh: 连续误导、语言歧视或人工服务不可达时停用AI层
scenarios.stop_en: Disable the AI layer after repeated misguidance, language bias or unavailable human service
scenarios.restore_zh: 撤除数字叠层，保留实体导视与座椅
scenarios.restore_en: Remove the digital overlay while retaining physical signs and seating

scenarios.title_zh: 季节与能耗公开的环境智能
scenarios.need_zh: 建筑与公共空间优先使用遮阳、通风和树冠，AI仅在低技术方案不足时介入。
scenarios.need_en: Buildings and public spaces prioritise shade, ventilation and canopy; AI intervenes only when low-tech measures are insufficient.
scenarios.ai_role_zh: 按需控制通风、遮阳和局部设备
scenarios.ai_role_en: On-demand control of ventilation, shading and local equipment
scenarios.minimum_data_zh: 温湿度、能耗与匿名占用量
scenarios.minimum_data_en: Temperature, humidity, energy use and anonymous occupancy counts
scenarios.human_route_zh: 设施控制室与手动开关
scenarios.human_route_en: Facility control room and manual switches
scenarios.ai_off_zh: 自然通风、固定遮阳与普通温控继续工作
scenarios.ai_off_en: Natural ventilation, fixed shading and ordinary controls remain
scenarios.stop_zh: 能耗或热排放超过试点阈值、自然路径被封闭时停止
scenarios.stop_en: Stop if energy or heat exceeds pilot thresholds or passive routes are blocked
scenarios.restore_zh: 撤除可移动设备，恢复被动式空间运行
scenarios.restore_en: Remove movable equipment and restore passive operation

scenarios.need_zh: 让智能退入背景，把人的注意力、身体和感官还给自然光、风、植物与真实邻里。
scenarios.need_en: Move intelligence into the background and return attention, bodies and senses to daylight, air, plants and real neighbours.
scenarios.ai_role_zh: 低干扰环境辅助、照护提醒与非强制界面服务
scenarios.ai_role_en: Low-interference environmental assistance, care reminders and non-mandatory interfaces
scenarios.minimum_data_zh: 本地即时环境数据；默认不保存个体行为
scenarios.minimum_data_en: Local real-time environmental data; individual behaviour is not retained by default
scenarios.human_route_zh: 社区前台和真人邻里服务
scenarios.human_route_en: Community front desk and human neighbourhood service
scenarios.ai_off_zh: 门窗、照明、座椅、纸本信息和真人服务全部可用
scenarios.ai_off_en: Windows, lighting, seating, paper information and human service all remain usable
scenarios.stop_zh: 屏幕负担增加、个性化监控或真人关系被替代时停用
scenarios.stop_en: Disable if screen burden rises, personalised monitoring appears or human relations are displaced
scenarios.restore_zh: 移除数字接口，空间继续作为社区客厅
scenarios.restore_en: Remove digital interfaces; the space remains a community living room

scenarios.need_zh: AI用于提示观察、讲述自然与京张历史，而不是把儿童重新拉回屏幕。
scenarios.need_en: AI prompts observation and tells natural and Jing-Zhang stories without pulling children back to screens.
scenarios.ai_role_zh: 语音式自然观察提示与离线故事触发
scenarios.ai_role_en: Voice-based nature prompts and offline story triggers
scenarios.accountable_role_zh: 儿童活动与安全负责人
scenarios.minimum_data_zh: 不采集儿童身份、声音或轨迹；只读取设施触发状态
scenarios.minimum_data_en: No child identity, voice or trajectory capture; only device trigger states
scenarios.human_route_zh: 带队教师、家长与实体说明牌
scenarios.human_route_en: Teachers, caregivers and physical interpretation panels
scenarios.ai_off_zh: 自然材料、游戏设施和实体展板继续完整使用
scenarios.ai_off_en: Natural materials, play elements and physical panels remain fully usable
scenarios.stop_zh: 出现儿童数据采集、注意力黏附或真人监督不足时停用
scenarios.stop_en: Stop if child data is collected, attention becomes sticky or human supervision is insufficient
scenarios.restore_zh: 撤走可移动设备，恢复不依赖数字界面的自然活动场
scenarios.restore_en: Remove movable devices and restore a nature-play area that does not depend on digital interfaces

scenarios.need_zh: 在人、轮椅、婴儿车和低速机器交汇处，优先保障净宽、可见性和人工协助。
scenarios.need_en: At a junction of people, wheelchairs, strollers and slow machines, protect clear width, visibility and human assistance first.
scenarios.ai_role_zh: 拥堵提示、路径建议与冲突预警
scenarios.ai_role_en: Congestion alerts, route suggestions and conflict warnings
scenarios.minimum_data_zh: 匿名人流计数与障碍状态
scenarios.minimum_data_en: Anonymous footfall counts and obstacle states
scenarios.human_route_zh: 有人值守的协助点与物理求助按钮
scenarios.human_route_en: Staffed assistance point and physical help button
scenarios.ai_off_zh: 连续无障碍路径、普通导视与人工协助保持
scenarios.ai_off_en: Continuous accessible route, ordinary signs and human assistance remain
scenarios.stop_zh: 净宽下降、无障碍任务失败或机器优先于人时停用
scenarios.stop_en: Disable if clear width falls, accessibility tasks fail or machines take priority over people
scenarios.restore_zh: 移除旁置设备，净空恢复为普通街角
scenarios.restore_en: Remove side-mounted equipment and restore an ordinary clear corner

scenarios.title_zh: 小店数字员工公示柜台
scenarios.need_zh: 顾客随时知道自己是否在与AI交互，并能在同一柜台完成真人咨询、纠错与退款。
scenarios.need_en: Customers always know when they interact with AI and can reach a human for advice, correction and refunds at the same counter.
scenarios.ai_role_zh: 商品问答、排队建议和多语沟通
scenarios.ai_role_en: Product Q&A, queue suggestions and multilingual communication
scenarios.minimum_data_zh: 当次问题和交易必要信息，默认不画像
scenarios.minimum_data_en: Session question and transaction-minimum data; no profiling by default
scenarios.human_route_en: Human takeover at the same counter
scenarios.ai_off_zh: 商品标价、人工收银和纸质凭证保持
scenarios.ai_off_en: Prices, staffed payment and paper receipts remain
scenarios.stop_zh: 误导交易、拒绝人工、隐性推荐或投诉无法处理时停用
scenarios.stop_en: Disable on misleading transactions, denied human service, hidden recommendations or unresolved complaints
scenarios.restore_zh: 移除AI终端，柜台恢复普通经营
scenarios.restore_en: Remove the AI terminal and return the counter to ordinary operation

scenarios.need_zh: AI只做健康导航和非诊断性提示，任何高风险情况立即转交具名真人。
scenarios.need_en: AI provides navigation and non-diagnostic guidance only; any high-risk case is transferred immediately to a named human role.
scenarios.ai_role_zh: 服务分流、康复设施导览和风险提示
scenarios.ai_role_en: Service routing, rehabilitation-facility guidance and risk alerts
scenarios.minimum_data_zh: 当次需求与自愿输入；不留存诊疗结论
scenarios.minimum_data_en: Session need and voluntary input; no diagnostic conclusion retained
scenarios.human_route_zh: 现场专业人员、电话和人工预约
scenarios.human_route_en: On-site professional, telephone and staffed booking
scenarios.ai_off_zh: 实体导视、人工问询与纸本流程保持
scenarios.ai_off_en: Physical signs, human inquiry and paper procedures remain
scenarios.stop_zh: 超出非诊断边界、人工不可达或误导风险时停用
scenarios.stop_en: Disable if it crosses the non-diagnostic boundary, humans are unreachable or risk of misguidance appears
scenarios.restore_zh: 撤除智能界面，保留普通健康服务台
scenarios.restore_en: Remove the intelligent interface and retain the ordinary health desk

scenarios.need_zh: 照明只在安全必要范围内工作，不把夜晚、鸟类和居民休息当作可被持续激活的资源。
scenarios.need_en: Lighting operates only where safety requires it and does not treat darkness, birds or residents’ rest as resources for continuous activation.
scenarios.ai_role_zh: 低照度按需启闭与匿名存在感知
scenarios.ai_role_en: Low-lux on-demand control with anonymous presence sensing
scenarios.accountable_role_zh: 夜间环境与生态负责人
scenarios.minimum_data_zh: 匿名存在信号与照度；不采集个体轨迹
scenarios.minimum_data_en: Anonymous presence signal and illuminance; no individual trajectories
scenarios.human_route_zh: 夜间巡查员与实体灯控
scenarios.human_route_en: Night steward and physical lighting controls
scenarios.ai_off_zh: 基础安全照明按固定低照度工作
scenarios.ai_off_en: Baseline safety lighting operates at fixed low lux
scenarios.stop_zh: 光溢出、持续高亮、野生动物干扰或传感越界时停止试验
scenarios.stop_en: Stop on light spill, sustained brightness, wildlife disturbance or sensing overreach
scenarios.restore_zh: 拆除试验模块，恢复暗夜基线
scenarios.restore_en: Remove test modules and restore the darkness baseline

scenarios.title_zh: 树根与土壤低扰动感知
scenarios.need_zh: 智能设施不得因安装、散热或维护压实土壤、切断根系或侵占微生境。
scenarios.need_en: Intelligent installations must not compact soil, sever roots or occupy microhabitats through installation, heat or maintenance.
scenarios.ai_role_zh: 土壤含水、温度与树体压力趋势提示
scenarios.ai_role_en: Trend alerts for soil moisture, temperature and tree stress
scenarios.accountable_role_zh: 园林与设备联合责任人
scenarios.minimum_data_en: Environmental data only; no people data
scenarios.human_route_zh: 园林巡检和手工土壤观察
scenarios.human_route_en: Landscape inspection and manual soil observation
scenarios.ai_off_zh: 树穴、透水地面和人工养护继续工作
scenarios.ai_off_en: Tree pits, permeable surfaces and manual care remain
scenarios.stop_zh: 根区施工、土壤压实、设备热害或维护不可达时停止
scenarios.stop_en: Stop on root-zone construction, soil compaction, equipment heat damage or inaccessible maintenance
scenarios.restore_zh: 完整拆除，回填透气土并复测根区
scenarios.restore_en: Fully remove, restore aerated soil and retest the root zone

scenarios.title_zh: 双门复核与人工申诉台
scenarios.title_en: Dual-Gate Review and Human Appeal Desk
scenarios.need_zh: 任何公共AI都有一个真实可找到的位置，说明身份、责任、数据、人工路径和停止方式。
scenarios.need_en: Every public AI has a physical place where identity, accountability, data, human route and stopping method are visible.
scenarios.ai_role_zh: 公开运行状态、解释与申诉路由
scenarios.ai_role_en: Public status display, explanation and appeal routing
scenarios.minimum_data_zh: 系统状态与匿名投诉分类
scenarios.minimum_data_en: System status and anonymous complaint category
scenarios.human_route_zh: 具名岗位、实体柜台、电话和纸本
scenarios.human_route_en: Named role, physical counter, telephone and paper route
scenarios.ai_off_zh: 实体公示、人工受理和纸本申诉继续工作
scenarios.ai_off_en: Physical notice, staffed handling and paper appeal remain
scenarios.stop_zh: 无责任主体、无法人工接管或信息不可核验时不得开放
scenarios.stop_en: Do not open without an accountable entity, human takeover or verifiable information
scenarios.restore_zh: 双门状态标记转为退役记录，空间继续作为普通公共柜台
scenarios.restore_en: Convert the dual-gate status marker to a retirement record; the space remains an ordinary public counter

scenarios.need_zh: AI系统必须证明自己不仅能上线，也能被完整撤除，并把空间、土壤和服务恢复到普通基线。
scenarios.need_en: An AI system must prove not only that it can launch, but that it can be fully removed and return space, soil and service to an ordinary baseline.
scenarios.ai_role_zh: 退役清单、残余影响提示和恢复复核
scenarios.ai_role_en: Retirement checklist, residual-impact alerts and restoration verification
scenarios.minimum_data_zh: 设备清单、材料、能耗和恢复记录
scenarios.minimum_data_en: Equipment inventory, materials, energy and restoration records
scenarios.human_route_zh: 专业拆除、公众公示和独立复核
scenarios.human_route_en: Professional removal, public notice and independent review
scenarios.ai_off_zh: 普通空间与人工服务先行存在
scenarios.ai_off_en: Ordinary space and human service exist first
scenarios.stop_zh: 无法无损拆除、残余数据未清理或生命基底未恢复时不得结项
scenarios.stop_en: Do not close if removal is damaging, residual data remains or living ground is not restored
scenarios.restore_zh: 恢复地面、土壤、树根、照明和普通服务，发布退役回执
scenarios.restore_en: Restore surface, soil, roots, lighting and ordinary service; publish a retirement receipt

truth_boundary: All scenarios are concept contracts. Observed values are null; no field authorisation or live service exists.
